title: Grateful Dead Live at John F. Kennedy Stadium on 1989-07-07
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-8 (with no Dolby) > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 2496. Taped and transferred by Andrew F. January 2009 - dts mixing by Kevin Tobin
source: DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix; - SBD (shnid = 140152) Recording Info: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90); Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) > KORG AudioGate 4 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24; All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller + AUD (shnid = 96993) 24bit 96kHZ file set. FOB AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's with no Dolby. Mics on 8-foot stand, approx 15 feet in front of SBD area and 15 feet to stage right (Phil side).

ai_review.summary: Excellent 5.1 surround mix captures a firing Philly performance with very few dull moments.
ai_review.review: Kevin’s surround‑sound matrix mix sounds crystal‑clear on a 5.1 system, delivering an immersive listening experience. The band was “firing on all cylinders” in Philadelphia, providing many highlights and almost no dead spots throughout the show.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 5‑star review praises both the musical performance and the high‑quality surround mix; strong positive sentiment but limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Surround (5.1) mix described as sounding really good, crisp and immersive on a multichannel system.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Generally strong set with many highlights and very few dull moments; the band maintained high energy throughout.
